title: Issue #396 provider-gate contract candidate v1
$comment: ExecutionPacketV1 and B1B2AdmissionStatusV2 fixed-shape objects are closed. A same-Red review pass remains a separate gate. E384-QUAL-001 is the sole quantitative and aggregation authority; P2 findings are record-only.

EvidencePath.description: Repository-relative POSIX path. Semantic validation also rejects an empty segment, a dot segment, an absolute path, NUL, backslash, symlink traversal, and duplicate paths.

x-hash-contract.manifest_core_sha256: SHA-256(ASCII(spec-dock.provider-gate.manifest-core.v1) || 0x00 || uint64_be(length(core_json)) || core_json), where core_json is canonical UTF-8 JSON plus exactly one terminal LF for fields 1 through 12
x-hash-contract.bundle_sha256: SHA-256(ASCII(spec-dock.provider-gate.bundle.v1) || 0x00 || raw32(manifest_core_sha256) || records), where wheel and sdist records are sorted by filename UTF-8 bytes and each record is uint64_be(name_length) || name_utf8 || uint64_be(metadata_length) || canonical_artifact_metadata_json || uint64_be(actual_length) || actual_artifact_bytes; metadata uses CandidateArtifactV1 field order
x-hash-contract.candidate_manifest_sha256: SHA-256 of the final distributed candidate-manifest.json UTF-8 bytes including its single terminal LF; it is recorded only outside CandidateManifestV1 and is not an input to manifest_core_sha256 or bundle_sha256

x-source-resolution.pull_request: source_sha is github.event.pull_request.head.sha and source_repository is github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name; raw GITHUB_SHA is the merge-branch SHA and is never candidate identity
x-source-resolution.workflow_dispatch: source_sha is a required workflow input named source_sha and pull_request_number is null; branch tip and raw GITHUB_SHA do not substitute for the input
x-source-resolution.merge_group: source_sha is the event's GITHUB_SHA, which GitHub defines as the merge-group SHA, and pull_request_number is null
x-source-resolution.all_events: source_tree is resolved from the exact source repository and source_sha; every role checks out that same SHA and verifies the same tree before test execution

EnvironmentFingerprintV1.x-fingerprint-contract: fingerprint_sha256 is SHA-256 of canonical fields 1 through 19; null means not applicable or not collected, never an omitted field or a string placeholder. linux-canonical admission rejects null capability fields.

AttemptRegistrationV1.x-attempt-id-contract: attempt_id binds repository_id, workflow_id, workflow_run_id and the first started run identity; run_attempt>1 is retained and rejected as rerun. P2 wording divergence remains record-only until separately adjudicated.

x-semantic-invariants: cannot serve as build/materialization evidence
all role identities are complete before role start

ProcessMetricsV1.x-acceptance-rule: Parent thresholds are evaluated from raw integer time and CPU fields using exact arithmetic. cpu_wall_ratio_decimal is display-only and never determines acceptance.

x-array-order.role_results: role order candidate-producer, static-analysis, linux-canonical, sdist-smoke, macos-delta

x-semantic-invariants: status=accepted iff accepted=true
accepted requires complete identity and raw evidence
accepted requires every required role and parent predicate to pass
missing evidence is incomplete and never success

x-array-order.members: chronological created_at ascending, then numeric workflow_run_id ascending

x-semantic-invariants: member population is selected by generated E384-QUAL-001 policy
started failures, cancellation, interruption, and missing evidence remain members
status=accepted iff accepted=true
expected_fault_ids is frozen before execution
executed_fault_ids equals expected_fault_ids for a complete result
detected_fault_ids union missed_fault_ids equals expected_fault_ids
accepted requires zero misses

x-array-order.members: chronological created_at ascending, then numeric workflow_run_id ascending

x-semantic-invariants: membership uses the generated E384-QUAL-001 window policy
failure/cancel/interruption/missing evidence remain members
status=accepted iff accepted=true
status=accepted iff accepted=true
accepted requires all four evidence references and all referenced aggregate results accepted
missing reference is incomplete and never success
directory size and digest are null
regular-file digest hashes actual bytes
symlink digest hashes link-target bytes and traversal never follows a symlink
every listed root must exist
no absolute path is emitted
capture aborts on unsupported file type, mutation during read, missing root, or output inside a protected root
output has no timestamp so byte equality is a valid before/after comparison

CheckpointInputV1.x-stage-contract: P00-P04 preflight; P05 emits candidate-bound; P06-P22 candidate-bound except poisoned-stop returns.

x-semantic-invariants: implementation_authorized=true requires B1 and B2 performed and accepted at the same exact corrected predecessor SHA/tree; both accepted identities equal predecessor_human_merge.merge_sha/merge_tree

implementation_authorized=true requires predecessor_human_merge.issue_branch_ancestry_status=verified; the recorded ancestry evidence must prove merge-base --is-ancestor of that corrected merge SHA and spec_freeze_sha

implementation_authorized=true requires same-Red review_status=pass, p0_count=0, p1_count=0; reviewed_sha/tree equal spec_freeze_sha/tree; review evidence, Issue projection readback, dispatch receipt are non-null; concurrent_writer_absent=true
assignment nodeid set equals both collected sets
each node has exactly one owner
owner_counts equal assignment counts
no owner is derived from fast/full_regression markers
runtime collection with an unlisted node is rejected before test execution
physical absolute root is runtime-only and never serialized
not a final-gate attempt
no attempt_id or history membership
poisoned source SHA/tree cannot materialize again
created only after materialization is complete
immutable before first campaign attempt registration
B2 cannot be accepted unless B1 is accepted first; acceptance order is recorded in required_order
accepted B1 and B2 each have performed execution, exact SHA/tree, and a stage-correct PreflightEvidenceIndexV1
accepted B1 and B2 identities are equal to each other and the corrected owner-accepted predecessor merge identity

issue_branch_ancestry_status=verified means the corrected predecessor merge SHA is an ancestor of the exact Issue specification freeze SHA; the evidence ref contains the actual read-only command result
